verdict.rationale: The SDK docs name bulk task management as a use case: scripting the creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks across one or many projects. The orchestration docs describe fanning a refactor or migration out across several worktrees at once, and the CLI and MCP server expose workspace, task, and automation management that can be scripted. A power user also reports running 40-50 agent sessions across repos simultaneously. Missing for 10: native multi-select or bulk actions in the UI, a dedicated batch API endpoint (bulk work appears to rely on scripting loops), and hands-on corroboration of bulk task scripting specifically.
